BUCKET (added 2026-09-23 by the product owner): percentages beside the ANALYZE level counts. Agreed design after measurement, not the raw version: whole numbers (one reading is 0.7% of the sample, so a decimal implies resolution the data lacks); the distinct-day count printed beside the reading count (145 readings spanned only 25 local days, so the standard error on the 47% share is 10.0 pp by days against 4.3 pp by readings); and a 'close to even' line when the increased/decreased gap is under about two standard errors on the day count. At 3.13% the split was 47/43 -- 0.4 SE, a coin flip that a bare percentage would make look like a lean. At 2.29% it was 70/25 on 20 days, 4.5 SE, and that call came true at +1.68 pp. The later half of the idea -- how often the section was right, conditioned on the news at the time -- is calibration (z = +2.23 day level, needs about 171 independent days, we have 42) and news conditioning is two gates beyond that.
